title: Ideas about a new programming language for games.
summary: Jonathan Blow's first talk on designing a new programming language for games, which became Jai. He explains the problems with C++ and why Go, Rust and D do not fit game development.
why: HN programmers recommend it, and the Jai series that followed, for the game-industry view on replacing C++ and for watching a language being invented.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: I also found watching his process for inventing the language extremely instructive, just as a programmer.
